$comment: LitNode gauntlet config for Rapture Chess (node/gauntlet.js). For every match of a title this node hosts with this file, it spawns relay/server.mts for that match alone: the node mints the seat tickets, proxies wss://<wsAddr>/<room> to the process, and the process posts the ledger to the node's /ledger and exits. The node passes GAUNTLET_RULESET, so one file serves both rapture-chess.v1 (no clock in the log, CHESS_TURN_MS per move) and rapture-chess.v2 (CHESS_TC base minutes + increment seconds, CHESS_FIRST_MOVE_MS for each side's first move). Copy this file, set cwd to your Rapture Chess checkout (pnpm install at its root), then in the node's environment: GAUNTLETS=rapture-chess.v2=<absolute path to your copy> (comma-separate a v1 entry while v1 is still served), RULESETS=<checkout>/rulesets/rapture-chess.v2.js, and RELAY_KEYS=<the public key scripts/relay-key.mjs prints> so a match the loser never signs still settles. The GAUNTLET_* variables are set by the node per match.
